aiMetadata.description: Fetch the full details of one Foreplay ad by its ad ID. Use when you already have a specific ad ID (e.g. from a search or a trigger) and need its complete metadata. Requires the exact ad ID; read-only, so repeating the call is safe.

getAdsByPage.name: getAdsByPage

end_date.description: End date (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS

order.description: Order of results: newest (default), oldest, longest_running, or most_relevant

live.description: Filter ads by live status. true means currently active ads, false means inactive ads.

display_format.description: Filter by one or more display formats

publisher_platform.description: Filter by one or more publisher platforms

niches.description: Filter by one or more niches

languages.description: Filter by languages. Accepts various language formats.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the cursor value from the previous response.

limit.description: Pagination limit (default 10, max 250). Controls the number of ads returned per request.

aiMetadata.description: List the ads run by a specific advertiser, keyed by their Facebook Page ID, with optional filters (date range, platform, format, niche, market, language, live-only) and cursor pagination. Use when you want every ad from one known page rather than a free-text search across all advertisers. Requires the Facebook Page ID; read-only, so repeating the call is safe.

findBrands.name: findBrands
findBrands.description: Search for brands by name with fuzzy matching.

query.description: Brand name to search for (e.g., "Nike", "Apple"). Supports fuzzy matching for partial names.

aiMetadata.description: Search the Foreplay brand directory by name using fuzzy matching, returning matching brands. Use to resolve a brand name to its Foreplay brand record (e.g. to discover a brand ID before fetching its ads). Requires a query string; read-only, so repeating the call is safe.

findAds.name: findAds
findAds.description: Search and filter ads by text, dates, platforms, and categories.

query.description: Search text for ad name or description. Leave empty to search all ads with filters only.

start_date.description: Start date (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS

end_date.description: End date (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS

order.description: Order of results: newest (default), oldest, longest_running, or most_relevant

live.description: Filter ads by live status. true means currently active ads, false means inactive ads.

display_format.description: Filter by one or more display formats

publisher_platform.description: Filter by one or more publisher platforms

niches.description: Filter by one or more niches

languages.description: Filter by languages. Accepts various language formats.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the cursor value from the previous response.

limit.description: Pagination limit (default 10, max 250). Controls the number of ads returned per request.

aiMetadata.description: Search the Foreplay ad discovery library across all advertisers, optionally filtered by free-text query, date range, platform, display format, niche, market, language, and live-only status, with cursor pagination. With no query or filters it returns the broad feed; supply filters to narrow to matching ads. Use for cross-advertiser ad research rather than pulling ads for one known page. Read-only, so repeating the call is safe.

findBoards.name: findBoards
findBoards.description: Get all boards for the authenticated user with pagination.

aiMetadata.description: List the saved ad boards belonging to the authenticated Foreplay account, with offset/limit pagination. Use to discover available board IDs and names, for example before watching a board for new ads. Read-only, so repeating the call is safe.
